text:
sasha: handing off an ongoing alert — ratewave affecting embeddings path. Primary for the shift is me (sasha). paging started ~4287654300, bot escalated. summary: p99 qps spike + headroom drain on eu-west replicas, some requests are hitting retry budget and falling back to slower model variants. customer-facing impact: intermittent 5-15s tail latency for embeddings; few customers reported timeouts.

incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-qps-spike (sev3) — 2.1x baseline qps, p99 latency 12.4s, evictions increased. link: https://monitoring.example/alerts/4287654321

zhen: thanks. quick checklist: 1) confirm primary/secondary 2) confirm mitigation steps in playbook 3) note any coverage gaps for next shift.

sasha: primary = sasha (me). secondary = mike (oncall-in-30m). ops-bridge will stay as bridge until handoff completes. carla is watching customer escalations.

mike: I can be secondary. ETA ~25m. will take over if spike persists.

carla: flagged a support ticket from acme-inc — they see 504s. added to customer-incident tracker. I'll keep them updated and request logs.

sasha: current mitigations in progress: 1) temporary scale-up of eu-west embeddings pool (requested autoscaler + manual add) 2) enable safe-rate-shed policy for non-critical embedding routes 3) promote cached prefix for top-20 customers.

sasha: actions I already ran:
```
# add two gpu nodes to eu-west embeddings pool
redwoodctl compute add --region eu-west --pool embeddings --count 2
# enable rate-shed for background embedding jobs
redwoodctl config set rate_shed.background_embeddings=true
```

incident-bot: ACTION LOGGED: scale-up requested by sasha. expected node ready ~3m.

zhen: check the KV cache hit rate and prefetch backlog. if cache hit drops below 85% we should widen cache TTL for the day. Also watch the eviction metric: embeddings.kv.eviction_rate.

sasha: cache hit is currently 78% and eviction_rate is elevated (see snippet). I'm bumping TTL for hot prefixes to 6h.

sasha: log snippet:
```
[4287654335] embeddings.kv.hit_rate=0.78
[4287654335] embeddings.kv.evictions_per_min=320
[4287654335] eu-west.pool.util=0.92
```

mike: if pool util stays >0.9 after new nodes join we'll need to consider routing some low-priority customers to the fallback variant (quantized-lt). that's higher latency but cheaper. set canary to 1% then ramp if stable.

sasha: agreed. plan: 1% canary for quantized-lt on non-SLA customers, code: `routing set-variant --route embeddings.v1 --variant quantized-lt --weight 0.01` 2) monitor p50/p95/p99 and error_rate for 10m windows before ramp.

carla: customer comms: I posted in #support with initial note, tagging product and success. will update Acme after we confirm scale completes.

ops-bridge: bridging now: https://meet.example/bridge/4287. Add events to the bridge as they happen.

zhen: runbook pointers for whoever picks up: playbook section "embeddings-qps-spikes" -> steps 1-6. quick path: check `embeddings.*` dashboards, then `redwoodctl compute list --region eu-west`, then `redwoodctl routing list --route embeddings.v1`. If you need to rollback changes: `routing set-variant --route embeddings.v1 --variant baseline --weight 1.0`.

sasha: current blockers: scaled nodes are provisioning but one boot failed (driver mismatch). I'm spinning a replacement. ETA for full pool healthy ~8m.

mike: noted. will stand by to take primary if provisioning doesn't finish. Also can run driver update: `redwoodctl node update-driver --node <id> --driver v470` if needed.

incident-bot: NOTE: provisioning event recorded 4287654360, node-237 failed bootstrap. auto-retry scheduled.

sasha: mitigation status snapshot: scale-up requested ✅ (in-progress), TTL bump for hot prefixes ✅, 1% canary planned ⬜, routing fallback ready ⬜, customer comms in progress ✅.

carla: Support ticket IDs: SUP-9876 (Acme), SUP-9877 (beta-corp). I've asked for logs and will escalate if errors persist.

mike: handoff instructions for next primary: if you inherit this, verify pool util <0.85 for 10m, verify cache hit_rate >= 85% and evictions < 50/min. If not, proceed to routing fallback and open sales/ customer comms.

sasha: additional notes: there is a known coverage gap for eu-north region between 02:00-05:00 UTC due to scheduled maintenance; if the spike moves to eu-north we'll need to consider cross-region routing to eu-west or eu-central. flagging it here.

zhen: good call. add this to the handoff checklist in the runbook so next shift is aware.

sasha: leaving this in ops-bridge. my status when handing off at 4287654400: pool util trending down (0.82), cache hit 82% (improving), p99 down to 9.3s from 12.4s. leaving follow-ups: finish canary ramp if stable, monitor evictions, confirm node bootstrap.

mike: I will take over if it's still noisy at handoff. otherwise I'll ack and watch for 2h.

carla: I'll keep messaging customers and post updates in #support.

ops-bridge: capturing final state. Bridge will remain open until next primary acknowledges.

sasha: handing off now. thanks all. :thumbsup:
